drop.name: Tollman Brine
drop.description: A jar of black water wrung from a drowned tollman's coat. It is saltier than the sea that took him.

trophy.name: Rusted Toll Token
trophy.description: A green-crusted token stamped with a gate that no longer stands. He still clutched it when he fell.

gear.name: Tollkeeper Hook
gear.description: A short iron hook once used to drag fares from the water. You find it is still sharp.
